title: Joseph S. Clark High School's first class and band directors
summary: He was in the pioneer class at Clark, with Gordon Garnier then Emory Fears as band director.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: You know, to what we are today. Some of the leaders of today. So we would read. Music came to me a little bit easier after I went to high school. And that was in 1948, 49 session. Mm-hmm. And this was the beginning of Clark High School.
What, the first class you were in there?

Well, we were in the first June graduation class. Okay. Because in that, in those days you went to school in January and you went to school in September. Mm-hmm. So you graduated in January or June is the way it was set up.
And it was a platoon system when I first went to school. There was so many, so many kids that had to go to school. We went to school at seven o'clock in the morning.

Oh, yeah. Okay. It was a, it was down on the main street. It was an old bell school. Mm-hmm. And that was our first school and they moved to Barracks in Robes, Durban in 1950. About 1950 they moved there. So in June of 52 was the first graduating class of Joseph S. Clark. Mm-hmm. You were there? I was in it and I was in the band. In the band we had 65 people.
Well, name, actually the name of all 65. Who?
Who? Who? Who? Who? Who was, who was band director? The band, first band director.
The band, first band director was Gordon Garnier. Gordon Garnier. Gordon Garnier was also a local trumpet player with the Dookie Chase Orchestra. Oh, okay.
And he was, yeah. Probably a photograph here someplace.

Probably is. Just a little light-skinned shark Creole who could really play. Yeah. And the, and then the, the instructor who took over for him next year was Emory Fears. He was an alto player from up in the Pittsburgh area. Okay. He is now, well I saw him about, gee, is that long ago? I'm just thinking. In 86. Saw him up in Philadelphia. He was a band director. And he's at a university of what? I think it's the University of Philly. He was band director, still band directing.
